focus: correctness — frontmatter-strip boundary, render fallback contract, and durable budget arithmetic

findingDetails.title: Opening or closing fence with trailing whitespace leaks frontmatter into every goal surface
findingDetails.evidence: FRONTMATTER_PATTERN requires "---\n" exactly; the validator boundary at continuity-freshness.ts:17 allows "---\s*\r?\n". Observed through the shipped module: for a document whose opening fence is "--- " (trailing space), splitFrontmatter returns frontmatter:null and renderChatSlice returns the YAML block including session_id: SECRET, while FRONTMATTER_RE matches the same bytes and extracts it as frontmatter. No test pins the two regexes together: goal-slice.test.cjs:66 covers only the well-formed fence and the golden parity test ADR-003 promises was not found.
findingDetails.impact: A malformed-but-plausible fence ships the continuity block and session id to chat, CLI show/packet and the injection path, exactly the leak ADR-003 exists to prevent; the validator and the runtime disagree about the same file.
findingDetails.recommendation: Amend the extractor to the validator boundary (allow trailing whitespace before both fence newlines) and add the golden parity test ADR-003 promises. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: goal-slice.cjs:14-37 and cli/validation/continuity-freshness.ts:17 read directly; leak reproduced through the shipped module with node on a fixture document.

findingDetails.title: Pointer-less records still inject their stored objective, contradicting ADR-001/ADR-002 and the hook README
findingDetails.evidence: renderGoalBrief seeds objectiveSource from goal.objective and only overrides it when packetPath is present (:394-401); the plugin does the same (opencode-goal.js:2713-2720). ADR-001 (decision-record.md:73) says "A missing pointer means the session is unbound: no injection, no fallback"; ADR-002 (:159) says "a record without a pointer injects nothing until a bind"; README.md:37 lists unbound as producing no block. The executable contract pins the opposite: goal-core.test.cjs:824 ("unbindGoal drops the pointer and the record renders from its stored copy again") and goal-pi.test.mjs:227 injects a core.setGoal record with no packetPath; 004 implementation-summary.md:76 records the intent "an unbound record renders exactly as before".
findingDetails.impact: A follow-on implementer trusting the frozen ADRs would add a gate that breaks three shipped tests and the 004 phase intent; doc authors reading README:37 describe behavior the runtime does not have. Legacy pointer-less records (ADR-002 risk row) depend on the fallback to stay valid.
findingDetails.recommendation: Decide the truth and reconcile: either amend ADR-001/ADR-002/README to say a pointer-less active record renders its stored operator copy until a bind, or change code and tests. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both render paths, both pinning tests, the 004 implementation summary and the three ADR/README sentences read directly.

findingDetails.title: ADR-006's set-time consumer length check is absent; over-budget objectives truncate silently
findingDetails.evidence: clampText (:236-243) truncates with an ellipsis and no signal. setGoal wraps the objective in sanitizeInlineText(objective, 4000) (:1115) and bindGoal does the same to packet.objectiveSlice (:932); the plugin mirrors both (opencode-goal.js:1758,1820) and no warn/error path exists. ADR-006 decision (decision-record.md:560) promises "a consumer-side length check at set time". The only enforcement found is the TypeScript validator (spec-doc-structure.ts:1041-1058, warn 3000/error 4000), which the set path does not consult.
findingDetails.impact: An operator pasting a 5,000-character objective loses the tail silently, and the tail is where DONE WHEN criteria live; the record then judges completion against a truncated condition with no diagnostic.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the promised consumer-side check (warn past the warn tier, refuse or explicitly report truncation at the error tier) in core and plugin, or amend ADR-006 to scope enforcement to the validator. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: clampText, both set/bind call sites in core and plugin, and the ADR text read directly; validator rules and their tests read for contrast.

findingDetails.title: Plugin brief cache keys on state-file mtime:size, not the packet slice hash ADR-004 requires
findingDetails.evidence: readGoalForBrief builds cacheKey `${fileStats.mtimeMs}:${fileStats.size}` from the per-session state file (:2790) and never consults the packet durable-slice hash. ADR-004 constraints (decision-record.md:349) state "The plugin brief cache must key on the hash (opencode-goal.js:43)". The render path re-resolves the packet at each injection (resolvePacketGoalForRecord, :2701-2704), so no stale packet text was observed; the deviation is the unmet constraint.
findingDetails.impact: The cache cannot observe a packet-side change and the frozen constraint is unmet; future caching of the rendered block on this key would freeze the directive.
findingDetails.recommendation: Include the packet hash in the cache key or invalidate on hash change, or amend the ADR-004 constraint. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: readGoalForBrief and both packet-resolution sites read; the ADR-004 constraint sentence read.

focus: security — packet-path escape, log serialization, lifecycle state transitions

findingDetails.title: Symlinked packet path escapes the workspace: bind reads and log writes a goal.md outside it
findingDetails.evidence: resolvePacketDir refuses only lexical escapes (resolve/relative, :131-138); a symlinked directory inside the workspace resolves textually and readPacketGoal follows it. Observed with the shipped CLI on a fixture: workspace with linked-packet -> /tmp/gt-escape/outside, `goal.cjs bind linked-packet --runtime Pi --session s1 --workspace ws` returned STATUS=OK mutation=bound, and `goal.cjs log "escape probe | Done | wrote outside"` appended that row into /tmp/gt-escape/outside/goal.md. ADR-001 constraint (decision-record.md:57) and README.md:60 require the path to resolve inside the workspace; goal-core.test.cjs:795 covers only the lexical ../outside case.
findingDetails.impact: A committed or planted symlink turns a packet path into a read and, through the blessed log action, a write outside the workspace; the directive and the progress row leave the repository.
findingDetails.recommendation: Realpath the resolved packet directory and goal file and refuse targets outside the workspace, or reject symlinked packet directories. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: resolvePacketDir and readPacketGoal read; escape reproduced end-to-end through bin/goal.cjs bind and log with observed envelopes and the mutated outside file.

findingDetails.title: Log serialization is stateDir-scoped and the durable-slice guard is an advisory pre-write check
findingDetails.evidence: appendGoalLog takes withFileLocks(goalScope.stateDir, [packetLockName(...)]) (:1046) where packetLockName hashes workspace+packetPath (:894); the lock directory lives under the caller stateDir. Two sessions resolving different state roots (OPENCODE_GOAL_STATE_DIR, exercised by the suite) share no lock, so their appends are not serialized. The hash guard (:1069) is a re-read inside the lock that refuses after the fact, not a compare-and-swap; a writer that does not take the lock can still interleave. The suite pins same-state-dir behavior only (goal-core.test.cjs:832).
findingDetails.impact: The documented "per-packet lock" (README.md:60) is per state-dir, not per packet; cross-state-dir sessions can interleave log rows and a non-cooperating writer can lose a row.
findingDetails.recommendation: Document the state-dir precondition or move the packet lock to a packet-derived location outside the per-session state root. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: appendGoalLog, packetLockName, acquireFileLock/withFileLocks and the same-state-dir test read directly.

findingDetails.title: OpenCode plugin exposes no unbind and no log action, so ADR-007's log authority is unreachable through the primary tool
findingDetails.evidence: GOAL_ACTIONS (:168) is [set, bind, resent, packet, show, clear, complete, pause, history, resume, doctor, health]; grep finds no appendGoalLog or unbind in the plugin. /goal-opencode contract lists the same set, and README row documents OpenCode as "bind, resent and packet". Core and bin/goal.cjs both expose unbind and log (core ACTIONS; goal-core.test.cjs:841 exercises them). ADR-007 blesses auto-update writing only the log; ADR-005 puts pi and opencode at full capability.
findingDetails.impact: On OpenCode the model cannot append the progress row the reconciliation decision authorizes and cannot unbind to leave a packet, so the workflow instruction would fall back to hand-editing goal.md (which the posture restricts) or a raw CLI call the agent may not have.
findingDetails.recommendation: Expose log and unbind through the plugin tool and /goal-opencode, or amend ADR-005/007 to scope them to the CLI. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: GOAL_ACTIONS, the command file, the README row, core ACTIONS and the CLI tests read directly.

findingDetails.title: Setting a new objective on a bound record silently drops the packet pointer
findingDetails.evidence: On a changed objective the plugin setGoal takes the replaced branch and returns buildNewGoal(...) (:1792-1793), a fresh record with no packetPath/workspace/boundAtMs; core setGoal mirrors it through buildNewRecord (:1140-1150). Only unbindGoal is documented as dropping the pointer (README.md:60, unbindGoal :959-972), and ADR-001 says the pointer is written only by a deliberate bind. No test covers set-on-bound; goal-core.test.cjs:824 covers explicit unbind.
findingDetails.impact: A bound session that sets a refined objective silently leaves the packet: no packet injection, no resend tracking, and the reminder stops, with no mutation signal that the bind was lost.
findingDetails.recommendation: Preserve the pointer when the objective is replaced, or route the drop through unbind and say so in the mutation, or document that set is an implicit unbind. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both setGoal replacements and both unbind paths read; plugin and core record builders compared.

findingDetails.title: Rebinding never archives the prior record: core's replace branch is dead code and the plugin has no archive path
findingDetails.evidence: bindGoal computes base as a spread copy (:934-936) and then tests base === current (:937), which can never be true for a spread; the archiveGoalRecord call on that line is unreachable. The plugin bindGoal has no archive call at all (mutation is set to rebound, :1830), while set/complete/pause still archive (goal-core.cjs:1142,1177,1197). No test asserts an archived record after a rebind.
findingDetails.impact: Rebinding over a completed or replaced record loses the prior record instead of preserving it in the archive namespace the state model documents, weakening the retention story ADR-002 keeps the store for.
findingDetails.recommendation: Archive current when a rebind replaces a record in a non-active/paused state, and add a rebind test. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: bindGoal in core and plugin, archiveGoalRecord call sites and the state-layout docs read directly.

focus: traceability — runtime parity, release claims, requirement rows, and parity coverage

findingDetails.title: OpenCode injection carries no resend reminder although ADR-004 says the reminder rides the injection path
findingDetails.evidence: renderResendReminder is called only by the pi (goal-context.ts:197), cursor (goal-inject.mjs:84) and devin (goal-inject.mjs:70) adapters; renderGoalInjection (:2707-2759) builds the block without it and no plugin test asserts a reminder (opencode-goal-tool-path.test.cjs:186-194 asserts only resend_pending in tool output; plugin:2866 emits the field). ADR-004 decision (decision-record.md:354) states "The reminder rides the injection path and never blocks work", README.md:60 says "Adapters append renderResendReminder() to the injection", and CHANGELOG:303 tells users the agent "keeps reminding you to set it". 005 implementation-summary.md:3 documents reminders only for Pi and Cursor, so the narrowed scope exists in phase docs but not in the ADR/README/changelog.
findingDetails.impact: On the primary runtime the model sees a reminder only when it invokes the goal tool; between tool calls a stale operator copy is invisible, the exact gap ADR-004 injection-path sentence exists to close. A reader of the ADR/README/changelog would claim parity that 005 own summary denies.
findingDetails.recommendation: Append renderResendReminder (or an equivalent one-line marker) to the plugin injection, or amend ADR-004/README/changelog to scope reminders to Pi/Cursor/Devin and name the tool-output field as OpenCode signal. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All three adapter call sites, the plugin render/injection path, the tool-output field, the tests and the four documentation statements read directly.

findingDetails.title: Changelog contradicts itself on Devin: injection-only adapter regained vs 'deliberately decommissioned'
findingDetails.evidence: Line 303 (goal-unification section) says "Devin regained a goal adapter as injection-only"; line 305 says "Devin goal hooks were prototyped and then deliberately decommissioned, so Devin is not a goal target in the shipped release", while the hook README row 74 and .devin/hooks.v1.json:33,55 implement and document the adapter.
findingDetails.impact: Release notes give two incompatible answers about a shipped capability; adopters cannot tell whether Devin is a goal target.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite the stale sentence in the line-305 paragraph to match the line-303 amendment. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both changelog paragraphs, the README row and the Devin hook wiring read directly.

findingDetails.title: 009 REQ-010 still requires docs to call Devin decommissioned; ADR-005's promised amendment is absent
findingDetails.evidence: REQ-010 reads "Current docs/matrices state that Devin goal adapters were decommissioned; no registration or missing adapter path is claimed." ADR-005 ships Devin as new work and states "the hook README delivery matrix and 009 REQ-010 evidence row amended together". The README matrix was updated (row 74), the 009 requirement row was not; 009 implementation-summary still records zero Devin registrations as PASS.
findingDetails.impact: A tracked requirement now contradicts the shipped tree; a verification sweep re-reading 009 reports the adapter as a regression rather than a decision.
findingDetails.recommendation: Amend 009 REQ-010 row/evidence per ADR-005 (or add the superseding pointer to 036) and schedule it in phase 007 doc tasks. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: 009 REQ-010 text, ADR-005 amendment sentence, README matrix row and Devin registrations read directly.

findingDetails.title: Plugin bind stores an unresolved workspace through a dead ternary, drifting from core's repo-root resolution
findingDetails.evidence: The plugin stores `goalSlice.resolvePacketDir(workspace, ".") ? resolved : workspace` (:1838); resolvePacketDir(workspace, ".") returns null for every workspace (relative(".") is empty, guard at goal-slice.cjs:136), observed with node, so the ternary always falls back to the raw options.directory || process.cwd() (:1817). Core stores goalScope.workspace from resolveRepoRoot (goal-core.cjs:191), which walks up to .git/.opencode/skills (:135-144).
findingDetails.impact: Binding from a subdirectory fails on the plugin where the core succeeds, and a relative stored workspace would resolve against whatever cwd a later process has (resolvePacketGoalForRecord, :2701-2704). The dead ternary shows the normalization was intended.
findingDetails.recommendation: Resolve the workspace to the repo root before storing (or refuse non-root workspaces explicitly) and drop the dead ternary. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Plugin bind and record resolution, core resolveRepoRoot, and the resolvePacketDir return value read; the null return observed with node.

findingDetails.title: No parity test between core renderGoalBrief and plugin renderGoalInjection despite a byte-for-byte claim
findingDetails.evidence: README.md:37 claims the core block markers and labels "match opencode-goal renderGoalInjection byte-for-byte"; the two implementations are separate code paths (goal-core.cjs:389-448, opencode-goal.js:2707-2759) with duplicated constants. Grep finds no test that renders the same record through both and compares; goal-core tests assert substrings, plugin tests assert substrings and a no-SECRET shape.
findingDetails.impact: The compatibility guarantee between the two renderers is human-maintained; a one-sided edit drifts silently, as the reminder gap (F010) demonstrates.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a cross-implementation render test with one fixture, or downgrade the README claim. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both render functions, the README claim and the two test suites read directly.

findingDetails.title: Cursor command hint advertises actions the command contract fails closed on
findingDetails.evidence: The argument-hint reads "packet <packet-path> | set <objective> | show | clear | complete | pause | resume" (:3), while the contract (:17-19) fails closed with UNSUPPORTED_SESSION_BINDING for everything except packet, and the purpose section says anything that binds or mutates is unsupported (:13). README.md:74 documents Cursor as injection-only.
findingDetails.impact: Users invoking an advertised action get a capability error; the hint is the discoverability surface and contradicts the degraded-capability decision ADR-005 made.
findingDetails.recommendation: Trim the hint to the packet read with a note that management needs native identity. Report only; no fix in this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The command frontmatter, contract, purpose and README row read directly.

results.summary: Frozen ADRs and the shipped goal surfaces disagree on pointer-less rendering, set-time budget enforcement, workspace escaping and the OpenCode reminder path.
Phase 007 is a scaffold: T001-T009 unchecked and no verification evidence recorded; no false completion claim found.
The target is a spec folder, not a skill-agent pair.
Pi, Cursor and Devin match their decision rows; the OpenCode tool and injection surfaces diverge on actions, workspace normalization and reminder.
Feature catalog describes the packet-bound plugin; the 009 requirement row still calls Devin decommissioned.
Playbook, template and manifest carry the same 3000/4000 pair; the runtime set path does not enforce them.
